title: A reducer is modelled at its real length, not twice it
rule: تبدیل → ۲ جوش، و بدنه‌اش به طول واقعی B16.9 نه دو برابرش
note: The node sits at the CENTRE of an in-line body, so each weld is half the length away. Taking the full B16.9 overall length H as the take-out on each side made every reducer twice as long as the fitting it represents and shortened the pipe either side by about 100 mm at NPS 12. A 12-inch concentric reducer is roughly 203 mm end to end; the estimate od*0.62 lands at 201.
